	on_actions = {
		oe_v47_eu2_yearly_pulse

oe_v47_eu2_yearly_pulse = {
	trigger = {
		current_year >= 1444
		current_year <= 1590
		is_rebel_country = no

		NOT = { has_variable = oe_v47_eu2_ev_cd }
		OR = {

			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_v47_eu2_5_seen } }

				set_variable = { name = oe_v47_eu2_ev_cd value = 1 days = 360 }

			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_v47_eu2_9_seen } }
				set_variable = { name = oe_v47_eu2_9_seen value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = oe_v47_eu2_ev_cd value = 1 days = 360 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_v47_eu2.9
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				current_year >= 1444
				current_year <= 1570
				is_situation_active = situation:oe_sit_v47_samarkand_renaissance
				can_see_situation = situation:oe_sit_v47_samarkand_renaissance
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_v47_eu2_13_seen } }
